name: The Ferryman
description: A flat-bottomed ferry is tied up at a rickety landing. A hooded ferryman leans on his pole and calls out that he can take you a good way along, for a price.

initial.text: 'Water's the quick road, friend. I'll pole you a good stretch along your way and save your feet half a day. One hundred and fifty gold.'

haggle.success_text: He laughs and spits over the rail. 'A hundred, then, and you help with the ropes.'
haggle.failure_text: He shrugs. 'One fifty. Water doesn't haggle and neither do I.'

full-offer.text: 'One fifty, or the long way round. Your feet, your choice.'

pay-full.text: You hand over the gold and step down into the ferry. It rocks, settles, and pushes off.
pay-full.failure_text: You come up short. The ferryman shakes his head and goes back to leaning on his pole.

pay-haggled.text: You pay, take a rope, and the ferry pushes off.
pay-haggled.failure_text: You come up short. The ferryman shakes his head and goes back to leaning on his pole.

midstream.success_text: You spot the drowned log ahead in time and call it out. The ferryman poles around it with a grunt of thanks.
midstream.failure_text: The ferry slams into a drowned log and lurches. You're thrown hard against the rail.

snag.text: You pick yourself up, bruised and soaked to the knee.

landing.text: The ferry noses into a muddy landing well along your way. 'End of the line,' the ferryman says, already turning back.

exit.text: You leave the ferryman to his pole and keep to the path.
